newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU says vets Accor /Carlson global venture.
newsitem.headline: EU says vets Accor /Carlson global venture.

text.p: The European Commission said on Tuesday it had started a routine probe into a planned joint venture between Accor SA's subsidiary Compagnie Internationale des Wagons-Lits et du Tourisme SA and Carlson Travel Group Inc.

The $9 billion global merger of the business travel services of France's Accor and Carlson of the United States was submitted to the Commission on February 7 under the EU's merger rules which ban creation or strengthening of dominant positions.
The joint company would also carry on the leisure travel services of Wagons-Lits, the Commission said in a notice published in the EU's Official Journal.
The two partners already cooperate in the field of business travel.
The Commission has a month from the notification date to clear the deal or start an in-depth inquiry if it is worried about the impact on fair competition in Europe.
It has the power to vet all mergers involving companies with a combined worldwide turnover of five billion European currency units and 250 million ecus each in the European market.
